title: fr.audio_in.stream_start arguments
description: Starts streaming to the hub over HTTP (design D3). Dispatch never blocks: OK once the fr_stream task has the stream, BUSY while another runs, INVALID_ARGS for a rate the driver does not take. A connection that cannot be opened ends the stream with stream_ended net_lost (samples 0).

stream_id.description: issued by the hub; the POST path names it

sample_hz.description: absent: config sample_hz; one of the config's rates (Hz)
